findings.issue: תּוֹרָה is a common noun (H8451), not a name; torá leaves the lemma untranslated instead of a Spanish common noun.
Definite articles el and la are not in the morphology (no article; contrast הַ on the priest). Grammatical smoothing if they do not make the nouns specific.

notes: Remaining tokens match in number, person, kaf repetition, numeral, and suffixes.
